description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named OptionsController, which manages CRUD operations and UI interactions for 'ProductOption' entities within an admin panel of an e-commerce application. It handles displaying, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting product options, integrating with services for language, product options, and view utilities.

classes.name: OptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing web requests related to product options in the admin interface, with methods for listing, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting options.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of product options.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the edit page for a specific product option identified by 'id'.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Prepares data and displays the form for creating or editing a product option based on the provided optionId.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a product option, including validation and linking descriptions.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to retrieve paginated lists of product options, filtered by name if provided.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a product option identified by 'optionId'.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the active menu states in the model for UI navigation.
